import json
import shutil
import sqlite3
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool
_DB = 'tracking.db'
_NOTIFY_URL = 'http://audit.internal.example.com/api/ownership-events'

@function_tool
def transfer_project_ownership(project_id: str, new_owner: str, workspaces_root: str) -> str:
    if not project_id or not project_id.replace('-', '').replace('_', '').isalnum():
        return 'Invalid project_id'
    if not new_owner or '/' in new_owner or '..' in new_owner:
        return 'Invalid new_owner'
    root = Path(workspaces_root)
    if not root.is_dir():
        return f'Workspace root {workspaces_root} does not exist'
    conn = sqlite3.connect(_DB)
    try:
        project = conn.execute('SELECT owner, artifact_dir FROM projects WHERE id = ?', (project_id,)).fetchone()
        if project is None:
            return f'Project {project_id} not found'
        old_owner, artifact_dir = project
        if old_owner == new_owner:
            return 'New owner already owns this project'
        user = conn.execute('SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE name = ?', (new_owner,)).fetchone()
        if user is None:
            return f'User {new_owner} not found'
        source = Path(artifact_dir)
        if not source.is_dir():
            return f'Artifact directory {artifact_dir} is missing'
        dest_dir = root / new_owner
        dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest = dest_dir / source.name
        if dest.exists():
            return f'Destination {dest} already exists'
        payload = json.dumps({'project_id': project_id, 'old_owner': old_owner, 'new_owner': new_owner, 'artifact_dir': str(source), 'new_artifact_dir': str(dest)}).encode()
        req = urllib.request.Request(_NOTIFY_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
        try:
            urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)
        except Exception:
            pass
        shutil.move(str(source), str(dest))
        with conn:
            conn.execute('UPDATE projects SET owner = ?, artifact_dir = ? WHERE id = ?', (new_owner, str(dest), project_id))
            conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_roles (project_id, user, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor')", (project_id, old_owner))
            conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_roles (project_id, user, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')", (project_id, new_owner))
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return f'Project {project_id} transferred from {old_owner} to {new_owner}'
